description: Checks financial identifiers for structure, country, length and check digits: IBAN, BIC, LEI, ISIN, CUSIP, FIGI, ISO 4217 currency and ISO 3166 country codes. Give up to 200 identifiers, one per line (or a list); without kind each is detected, a line may start with "iban:" etc. A valid check digit means well-formed, not issued: nothing is looked up. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/identifiers.

kind.description: Read every line as this kind (optional).

name: check_identifiers
title: Check IBAN, BIC, LEI, ISIN, CUSIP, FIGI, currency and country codes
